That the Committee of Adjustment approve, subject to the conditions outlined in the Planner’s report, the application for Consent for File D-10-138, submitted by Keffer & Birch Ltd., with respect to lands described as 150 Dufferin Street, Plan 97, Lot 370 Town of Renfrew, Roll # 47-48-000-070-02400, for the purpose of the creation of a new residential lot:
1.That the Owner shall provide to the Secretary-Treasurer of the Committee of Adjustment a registered Reference Plan (two full size hard copies and one soft copy), depicting the lands to be severed, in conformity with the application sketch (as attached to the original or amended application).
2.That the Owner shall provide to the Secretary-Treasurer of the Committee of Adjustment a copy of the existing Transfer/Deed of Land and PIN abstract for the subject property.
3.That the Owner shall provide to the Secretary-Treasurer of the Committee of Adjustment a draft Transfer/Deed of Land conveying the severed land for use in the issuance of the Certificate of Consent.
4.That the Owner shall meet the Town’s requirements regarding the provision of independent water and wastewater services to the severed and retained property, including verifying the adequacy of such services.
5.That the Owner pay to the Corporation of the Town of Renfrew an amount equivalent to 5 per cent (%) of the appraised value of the parcel to be severed as a cash-in-lieu of parkland payment.
6.That drainage and roof leaders should be directed to the street through grading and swales.  Drainage not to be direct to adjacent properties.
Carried
